title: Dell security advisory (AV26-1027)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1027 Date: October 13, 2026 As of October 6, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Command | Configure (DCC) Prior to 5.2.3.35 Dell Container Storage Modules (CSM) Prior to 1.18.0 Dell OpenManage Integration with Microsoft Windows Admin Center (OMIMSWAC) Prior to 3.7.0 Dell Policy Manager for Secure Connect Gateway - Appliance Prior to 5.36.00.16 Dell System Update (DSU) Prior to 2.3.0.0 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. DSA-2026-442: Security Update for Dell OpenManage Integration with Microsoft Windows Admin Center DSA-2026-378: Security Update for Dell Command | Configure for Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-448: Security Update for Dell Container Storage Modules Multiple Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-324: Security update for Dell System Update (DSU) Vulnerabilities DSA-2026-385: Security Update for Dell Secure Connect Gateway Policy Manager Multiple Vulnerabilities Security Advisories, Notices and Resources Article Link: Dell security advisory (AV26-1027) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
